name: SOC SpyCloud Enterprise Protection
description: Enhancements for SpyCloud Enterprise Protection infostealer records used by the SOC Framework on Cortex XSIAM (Cloud IR). Reshapes infostealer records from `spycloudenterpriseprotectionfeed_generic_alert_raw` into properly-shaped XSIAM alerts with DS:SpyCloud/Enterprise Protection tags so Foundation Product Classification routes them. Credential material and personal data in the feed are never read.
author: Palo Alto Networks
